name: compaction
description: Context compaction strategies (summarize, drop, summarize-short, token-aware, trim, pass-the-baton)

reserveTokens.description: Token budget to reserve for the conversation

contextLimit.description: Context window size limit in tokens; defaults to the core contextLimit config

keepRecentMessages.description: Number of recent messages to keep after compaction

userTurnGuardPrompt.default: Continue from the compressed conversation context above.
userTurnGuardPrompt.description: Prompt added when compaction ends in a non-user turn to ensure compatibility with some LLM templates

batonNoticePrompt.default: We've reached the end of the session. Wrap up now: you must hand off to the next agent, informing them of the current status and how to continue where you left off.
batonNoticePrompt.description: System-notice text appended by pass-the-baton, ordering the model to stop and produce a handoff
